findings: over

Past their materials’ limits at their worst moment: Maintaining ratchet 1485 MPa in brass against 300–450 (3.55 N·m, The key let go outright); Maintaining clicks 2357 MPa in steel against 1200–1800 (2.16 N·m on the click wheel, The key let go outright); Fusee wheel 417 MPa in brass against 300–450 (The key let go outright).
near
Near their limits (a margin under 1.5): Maintaining detent 1114 MPa, margin 1.1 (The key let go outright).
over

The mainspring (0.37 mm) fully wound: 2663 MPa on its inner coils, 2367 along it, against its strip’s 2600 MPa: the inner coils, where the strip winds tightest round the arbor, carry more than its average.
over

The parts past their limits are all at the key let go outright: the fusee runs back onto its click (or pawl) and the blow passes to the maintaining work and the train. Easing the key back keeps them within their limits.
ok
The model’s own mechanism turns 8 arbors of the train at their tooth counts’ ratio, to 0.1 %.
